Nina: Pocket Heroes update — anyone want a casual capture-the-flag corner on Friday? thinking Steam Decks + Switch handhelds.
Omar: Love that. I can bring my Deck and a spare power bank.
Lee: I'll bring two Switches and a LAN dock. Can we do voice comms on a local channel?
Nina: Yeah local voice on Discord voice channel #lan-voice works. I'll post invite.
Omar: Should we set simple rules? 5v5, 3 captures to win, 12 min cap?
Lee: Works. Also can we put a soft rule: no griefing (spectator ban) and label controllers.
gl-bot: (automated) LAN voice invite posted: https://discord.gg/lan-night — fill RSVPs in the form please.
Nina: I'll add a tiny signup on the sheet: name, device, bring-hdmi-capture?
Omar: I can bring an HDMI capture for streaming highlights.
Lee: I'll bring sticky labels + Sharpies.
Nina: Snack signups in the sheet too. Adding: fruit + granola bars. Any allergies?
Omar: allergic to peanuts FYI.
Lee: noted. Also morning drop-off option? I can help set up at 6pm.
Nina: Perfect. Show-and-tell at 7:10, warmups at 7:30, CTF at 8pm. See ya.
Omar: In!
Lee: Count me in.
